fusions.name: Far-Sighted Cast
fusions.desc: Sights and throws a weighted thread at an enemy up to 8 tiles away, which deals 4 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at maximum range, and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Nothing Hidden
fusions.desc: Fires a fang at the first enemy it meets, which deals 30 damage that ignores armour and leaves it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Eight Ways Watching
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Look
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that fails to crit is rolled again, and the second roll stands.
